scope: Selected source-bound AC1018 TABLE cells preserve explicit group 177=0 with immediate group 178=0, separately from cells with neither group. Bare typed/manual and nonselected routes retain the pre-existing spelling; no default equivalence is assumed.
implementation: Capture validates the actual source callback and re-decodes its raw body with source codec, codepage policy and bounded work/memory before comparing typed source model. The adapter joins selected captured source and live TABLE models before writing. A separate nonvirtual writer method takes per-cell presence; the original writeTable signature remains unchanged. Existing rich TABLE graph is not required. Source re-key ambiguity, stale complete/incomplete models, duplicate/malformed presence and capture failure are refused transactionally. Deletion with no unmatched live TABLE remains allowed; a missing selected source plus unmatched live TABLE is refused as deletion-vs-rekey ambiguous. Linked ATTRIB/SEQEND on this profile remain refused pending separate proof.
